nina: Quick sync — hitting duplicate warmup traffic from two registries. Thinking of adding a small prefetch gating layer that uses a per-shard fingerprint to dedupe. Short thread.

ajay: How would the gate work?

nina: Loader lists annotations.idx (shard->fingerprint+tier). If fingerprint for shard is already in in-memory set (recently warmed), skip warmup. Otherwise fetch blob for policy and commit fingerprint.

courtney: That sounds good. Two things: how long do we keep the fingerprint (TTL) and how to deal with model rotation where same shard name could map to new data?

nina: Proposal: fingerprint TTL configurable (default 20m). Also require fp includes `epoch` (incremented on manifest updates). If epoch mismatch, treat as miss.

ajay: Any perf numbers?

infra-bot: Canary results: branch `prefetch-gate` reduces duplicate warmup requests by ~35% in mixed-registry replay. See ci/artifacts/prefetch-gate/summary.txt

courtney: Edge case: many ephemeral workers cold start simultaneously — we might end up with thundering herd if index not propagated. Loader should fallback to randomized jittered warmup and limited parallelism.

nina: Agreed. Add local singleflight per-fingerprint and jitter window [0, 2s]. Also cap concurrent warmups per node to 4 by default.

ajay: How do producers publish index? Atomic write to annotations.idx.v1.tmp then rename. Index entries include `shard`,`fingerprint`,`tier`,`epoch`. Keep compact newline-delimited JSON for easy streaming.

courtney: Security: don't include tenant or path info. Use opaque `src_hash`. Also ensure we never leak S3 URLs in annotations.

infra-bot: Added metrics planned: `prefetch_gate.hit`, `prefetch_gate.miss`, `prefetch_gate.throttle`, `prefetch_gate.epoch_mismatch`.

nina: Rollout plan: phase 0 producers emit index (no loader change). phase 1 opt-in loader flag (reads index + gating). phase 2 flip opt-in. phase 3 enable stricter verification for Dedicated.

ajay: I'll take the loader patch: singleflight by fingerprint, LRU TTL cache, feature flag `prefetch_gate`. Will instrument metrics.

courtney: I'll document index layout and the atomic write recipe and add a small CLI to convert legacy manifests to index.

nina: Thanks — opening RFC PR with schema, example index, rollout steps, and rollback plan. Tagging @ajay @courtney. :thumbsup:

(ends)
